scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible as it requires rerunning ab initio calculations; compare reported values to paper gold with tolerances and structural ordering checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold binding enthalpies and free energies for six molecules, and relative energies for DHB-Na+ isomers
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 4 (binding enthalpies/free energies) and Table 2 (MP2/b2//HF/b1 relative energies)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the published article
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the exact paper-reported numbers; they are not fabricated.

outputs.description: Sodium binding enthalpies and free energies at 298 K for the six MALDI matrix molecules DHB, SA, 4-HCCA, PA, NA, AA, computed at the MP2/6-311+G(2d,2p)//HF/6-31G* level including ZPVE and thermal corrections.
Relative enthalpies (ΔH298) of DHB-Na+ isomers 1-8 at the MP2/6-311+G(2d,2p)//HF/6-31G* level, with isomer 1 as reference (0.0 kcal/mol).

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the reported binding enthalpies and free energies to paper-reported values with appropriate tolerances, and verifies relative ordering and key energy differences for DHB isomers.
